title: Malmgren diaries record meetings with Richard Bissell

tellings.quote: I've also seen his diaries, which are now in a safe place and they're backed up, so don't mess with them. And I have seen a lot of meetings between Harold Malmgren and Richard Bissell.

plain: The private diaries of a man named Harold Malmgren record many meetings between him and another man, Richard Bissell. The journalist Ross Coulthart says on Michels's show in June 2025 that he has seen the diaries himself, and that they are now "in a safe place and they're backed up, so don't mess with them." He brings them up as written proof that the two men met often.
